sloka: ज्ञान वृद्धो वयो बालो मृदुर् वीर्य गुण अन्वितः ।अनुरूपः स वो भर्ता भविष्यति भय अपहः ॥२-४५-८॥
transliteration: jñāna vṛddho vayo bālo mṛdur vīrya guṇa anvitaḥ ।anurūpaḥ sa vo bhartā bhaviṣyati bhaya apahaḥ ॥2-45-8॥

translations.english: Though tender in age Bharata is mature in intellect. Gentle, valiant and virtuous, he will dispel all your fears and act as a true protector.
